A.value: *=Due to an error where voters received a ballot that was missing a school district question, voters were moved to precinct 7 in order to rectify the issue and provide them a ballot with the question.  As a result, at the end of the election, this resulted in a discrepancy in the number of voters who voted in precinct 6 vs the number of voters who appear to live in precinct 6.  For more information, please contact the Montezuma County Clerk & Recorder.
